scope: Matched frozen programmed teacher versus the six failed learned challenges. Same preview navigator, 120 mm plant, terrain, initial states and all physical gates. No new weights or altered mechanics.
stop_rule: Six teacher coarse conditions, at most one fine confirmation per audited success. No retries of failed conditions, navigator/teacher tuning, changed calibration, longer duration or weaker gates.

report.name: rough_slope+15-250us
report.navigation_localization: Exact simulator pose in an external navigator; actor receives its speed/yaw-rate command plus sensors.
limitations: Current detailed CAD; rigid tires, ideal gears, fixed slopes and nominal electrical/material priors.
Same actual-contact/hip-velocity standing gates as the terrain controller pilot.
Teacher labels use exact velocity and contacts. External navigation uses exact world pose; a student receives only the resulting command and its declared sensors.
This straight-driving cohort does not qualify turns, loose stones, recovery or hardware.

Only the low-level controller differs from the matched learned challenge. The coasting coefficient remains the student's fixed flat calibration, not a teacher fit. A teacher failure does not establish a hardware limit; no training or gain changes occur.
